acceptanceCriteria: Crystal glow is magenta and inviting
No firestorm and no frightened faces
Base lights are a small far clue, not the subject
No words, letters, logos, or UI chrome baked into the image
Kid-safe: wonder, effort, giggle, or rest — never horror or shame
Abby continuity when she appears: strawberry-blonde curls, blue eyes, pink-cream-cyan suit
sessionNote: MJ batch moonBase.emotional.v1. Serial only. Submit promptSeeds in order, one job at a time, ≥30s apart (≥120s between four-candidate grids). No auto-reroll. For singles, promptSeeds[0] is the composite to run; later seeds are optional finished-plate alternates. For packs (semanticId starts with pack. or game.), every promptSeed is its own asset.
